groups.defect: The membership routes disagree with the client URL and fail to provide the group_id parameter required by the handlers.
groups.rationale: Both explicitly report that routing fails to supply the required group_id, although they disagree about the generated route. s_5c133571 additionally reports that the client URL cannot match, so the merged comment must preserve that concern.

groups.defect: totalPages overcounts exact multiples of the page limit, enabling navigation to an empty extra page.
groups.rationale: All five identify the same floor-plus-one calculation and its consequences; replacing it with ceiling division addresses every report.

groups.defect: Public group member lists are truncated to 50 members without pagination controls to reach the remainder.
groups.rationale: Both report the same regression caused by applying pagination to non-automatic groups while leaving the public members page without navigation.
